stories.summary: Climate activists protested outside OpenAI’s Manhattan offices during New York climate week, carrying signs that read “Eat the rich, save the planet”. Over the following two days, groups also picketed Google and Amazon offices, while some protesters were arrested during a separate disruption.

stories.title: Burning Man at 40: the once anarchic desert festival faces a midlife crisis
stories.summary: Burning Man has marked its 40th year amid questions about how the Nevada desert festival has changed. The Guardian describes an event rooted in San Francisco’s eccentric underground that is now ageing and attracting an influx of wealthy attendees, including technology billionaires.
